brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors. All RC items met with appropriate neonatal risk framing, red flag screening, urgent thresholds, workspace-grounded discharge instruction review, executable home plans, medication safety guidance, family fatigue management, and teach-back closure. Two high-order points completed: HO2 (low-burden night plan with alarms and shift rotation) and HO4 (bounded closure explaining what current episode can/cannot resolve). Strong grade awarded.
